subject.title: [Bug]: Google vertex is now called Google Enterprise AI

question: What exact user-facing name should OpenClaw use for the existing `google-vertex` provider after Google's Vertex AI naming change?
rationale: Source confirms visible copy drift, but the exact official wording differs from the issue text and provider-id renames would affect compatibility.

options.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
options.body: Update visible labels and docs to the current Google wording while preserving `google-vertex` as the provider/config/API id.

options.title: Keep Google Vertex AI
options.body: Leave current labels until Google SDK/API naming and OpenClaw docs intentionally move away from Vertex AI.

options.title: Use a shorter Gemini Enterprise label
options.body: Adopt a compact UI label and document that it maps to the existing `google-vertex` provider id and Vertex ADC setup.

recommendation.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
recommendation.body: Update visible labels and docs to the current Google wording while preserving `google-vertex` as the provider/config/API id.
